name: Generic 80mm ESC/POS printer
notes: Fits most 203dpi 80mm receipt printers (Epson-compatible clones: Xprinter, Rongta, Munbyn, HOIN, ...).
Text size is capped at 4x to be safe; many printers go to 8x. Try `thermal set max_text_size 8` and a test print.
Run `thermal calibrate` to measure the real print width.
